sections.heading: 2. Description of the App
paragraphs: PhotoSpace is a local photo and video browsing utility.
The App allows users to make photos and videos stored on an iPhone or Mac accessible to other devices through a web browser over a local network.
Depending on the device, PhotoSpace provides functionality such as:

- Accessing photos and videos authorized by the user.
- Selecting media folders on Mac.
- Starting and stopping a local sharing service.
- Browsing shared media through a web browser.
- Viewing photo albums and media thumbnails.
- Accessing and downloading supported original media files.
PhotoSpace does not provide cloud photo storage.
The App is intended for local media access and browsing.

sections.heading: 3. Device and Network Requirements
paragraphs: PhotoSpace requires compatible Apple devices and operating systems.
To access shared media, the accessing device must be able to connect to the local sharing service.
The App's functionality may depend on:

- Local network connectivity.
- Device permissions.
- Operating system restrictions.
- Device performance.
- Supported media formats.
- Network configuration.
On iPhone, operating system restrictions may limit the availability of the sharing service when the App is in the background or the device is locked.
PhotoSpace does not guarantee uninterrupted operation or availability.

When the sharing service is active, devices that can reach the service may be able to access shared content.
